title: Bisexual Texturepack
description: It makes the logo, gui, hearts, xp bar and hotbar bisexual colours
body:
# Bisexual Texturepack

Express your pride and love with the **Bisexual Texturepack**! This vibrant pack features:

- A custom **Bisexual Minecraft logo**
- Colorful **hearts**
- Stylish **GUI elements**
- Enhanced **hotbar** and **XP bar**

Celebrate diversity and inclusivity while elevating your gameplay with this colorful and empowering texture pack!
